verdicts.recomputed: Own 62-contrast scan (verify3/c2.py, own v3a R reconstruction, 2h-block cluster SE). Omnibus correlation v3a vs v4 effects: 15m +0.001 (60 contrasts), 30m -0.075 (57); sign agreement 0.55 / 0.56. Direction A: 114 testable, 27 discovery p<0.05, 1 OOS one-sided p<0.05 (15m Europe, p1 0.0017). B: 107 testable, 7 carried, 1 OOS (15m Europe). No chart-context contrast replicated in A or B.
verdicts.note: Confirmed for chart context. Two caveats. (1) The 'no context replicates' wording must exclude the session: 15m Europe carries over in all three directions (analyst's own file: A p1 0.0026, q 0.074; B q 0.011; T p1 0.004). (2) v3a, the discovery set for A and T, has R that is confounded with leverage (see missed). BH was applied only within each direction's carried tests. The lens produced about 2,400 test rows (scan_full 1,323, scan_directional 567, sideflip 252, per_strategy 149, hypotheses 105, ...).

v3b and v4 match exactly. v3a differs slightly because of my independent shadow-to-R conversion. I did not re-run the ridge with side and coin as inputs. The sign flip alone makes any side-learning filter non-transferable.

verdicts.recomputed: Own chart-only ridge (11 chart features + tf, top third within run, 2h-block bootstrap; verify3/c4.py). v3a->v3b+v4: +0.089 R (CI -0.093..0.266). v3a->ds200: +0.061 (-0.189..0.296). v4->v3a+v3b: -0.088 (-0.227..0.018). Without the momentum features: +0.011, -0.015, -0.147.
verdicts.note: The claimed +0.11..+0.18 transfer does not reproduce, and one direction turns negative. Live data shows no transferable chart structure. The only support for a 'go with the move' preference is the 5-year DI-with / box-far-edge effect of about +0.04 R (CF3), worth at most 0.012 ROE.

verdicts.recomputed: 15m Europe minus rest: v4 -0.621 (n 121); v3a+v3b -0.342 (n 466), two-sided p 0.0012 (2h), 0.0032 (4h), 0.046 with KST-day clusters (df 4). After deduplicating identical signal moments: -0.302, day-cluster p 0.049. Long -0.120 (p 0.40) vs short -0.519 (p 0.0001). Per evening (Europe minus same day): 10/02 +0.36, 10/03 -0.43, 10/04 -0.25, 10/05 -0.37, 10/06 -0.36. 5-year: -0.040 / -0.021 R, ROE -0.003.
verdicts.note: The direction and the 5-year size reproduce. The corrections: (a) the natural unit is the evening, and the out-of-sample set has only 4 evenings, 1 of them with the opposite sign. With day clusters p is about 0.05, not 0.002. (b) The out-of-sample effect is almost entirely in shorts. In the v3b+v4 side-flip it is a direction-skill effect (-0.405, p 0.02), not timing. (c) BH q 0.011 is within a family of 7 carried tests; across all 77 carried out-of-sample tests q is 0.058-0.078. (d) summary.md, read before the pre-registration, already showed negative P&L in every exit hour 16-21 KST, so the session buckets were not chosen blind. The decision stays: a mild tie-breaker at most.

verdicts.recomputed: Live wide minus tight: 15m +0.206 (p 0.14), 30m +0.143 (p 0.13); v3a 15m +0.336, v4 15m -0.237. In v3a, tight-stop signals ran at 49.5x mean leverage and wide ones at 30.3x. Wide minus rest within leverage strata: 15m -0.003, 30m +0.071 (raw +0.288 / +0.219). 5-year, same 30x group, mean ROE: 15m tight -0.043 vs wide -0.043; 30m tight -0.039 vs wide -0.045. In R: 15m -0.398 vs -0.138.
verdicts.note: The live support is a v3a leverage artifact. The 5-year R effect is real, but in money it is zero: at the bot's fixed margin x leverage sizing, wide- and tight-stop signals have the same ROE. The R gain is a units effect (same P&L divided by a larger risk). So 'skip stops under 0.5%' and 'prefer 30m over 15m for cost' save no money unless sizing becomes risk-based (fixed USD risk per trade). The claim's own implication ('reduces drag') overstates the benefit.

verdicts.recomputed: Reduced side-flip check (10 binary contexts x core/ds200 x 15m/30m = 40 tests, v3b+v4 replay; verify3/c3.py). Direction skill: 4 raw p<0.05, 0 BH q<0.10. strategy_note_problems: N20_EMA9_CHOP 30m: all 56 live signals are shorts (long share 0.00) in mostly falling v3b/v4 markets. The positive side-flip (+0.36) and v4 +0.28 R are direction luck. The note does not say so.
Side-flip figures are (R - flip)/2 over v3b+v4 replays only (e.g. S4_BB_BBP 15m +0.390 = half of +0.779 on 39 signals), not labelled as half-differences or as excluding v3a.

N07_ICHI_CMO 30m is called the only core cell not clearly negative after 5-year filtering. With my filter, N17_KC_RSI 30m (-0.036, 6,327 kept) and N19_FIB_CHOP 15m (-0.040) are equally close, and N07's own SE (+/-0.027) overlaps them. It is not unique.

DeepSeek notes (F3_HHHL, F7_RF_TRIPLE, F6_VWAP_CROSS) rest on 2 KST days. F3_HHHL is 68% short in a falling market. Their positive side-flips are likely direction luck, and duplicate DeepSeek streams are not mentioned.
'C+' grades go to cells whose 5-year filtered mean is negative and whose live cluster SE is 0.15-0.45 R. The grade does not match the owners' 'not losing' criterion.
v3a cell means mix 20-50x leverage, and v3a R falls with leverage. Per-run v3a figures (e.g. N17_KC_RSI 15m -0.55, N25_DST_CCI 15m -0.67) are partly leverage, not strategy.
Sample check: S4_BB_BBP 15m/30m, N18 15m, N25 15m, N01 15m, N10 30m, N20 30m, N17 15m and F3/F7/F6/F4 15m reproduce within about 0.04 R (v3a varies slightly because of the R conversion).
missed: v3a leverage confound: mean R of core 15m+30m signals in v3a is -0.086 at 20x, -0.169 at 30x, -0.248 at 40x and -0.449 at 50x (the ROE-based ladder locks earlier at high leverage). Leverage was set by stop width (tight 49.5x vs wide 30.3x). Any v3a context correlated with stop width or leverage is biased, and v3a is the discovery set for directions A and T.
R versus money: at fixed margin x leverage, the 5-year stop-width R effect has zero ROE effect within the same leverage group. R-based 'cost' filters do not improve P&L unless sizing is risk-based.
Session buckets were not blind: summary.md (read before the pre-registration) showed negative P&L in every exit hour 16-21 KST.
The Europe effect is direction-specific (shorts) and a direction-skill effect in the side-flip. With evening clusters the out-of-sample test has 4 evenings (p about 0.05).

Duplicates: 3,646 core signals contain only 2,485 unique (run, tf, coin, bar, side) moments; 52% sit in duplicate groups. Tests count them as independent rows. After deduplication Europe is still p 0.002 (2h) but 0.049 (day).

Multiple testing: about 2,400 test rows across the lens tables, with BH applied only within small families (for example 7 carried tests). Across all 77 carried out-of-sample tests the best q is 0.047 (HTF middle) and 0.058-0.078 for Europe.
The live learned-filter results (CF6) are specification-fragile. A reasonable alternative ridge reverses the v4->v3a+v3b direction.
